note: Pre-rendered Blender Cycles plates (empty set, curved rail L-portal -> focus -> R-portal). All pixel values are in the plate's own pixel space (size). Shadow/refl masks are half resolution and cover the full frame. Shadow masks: black + alpha = shadow strength for a jersey hanging at shadowPositions[i] (interpolate between neighbours). Refl mask: white + alpha = where the wet floor mirrors. occl: full-res RGBA of the wall/portal edges to draw IN FRONT of jerseys that are behind the wall plane (path[].behindWall). path[]: s = arc length m (0 = focus, negative = left room), x/y = rail centre px, hx/hy = hook point px, ppm = px per metre (perspective scale), scale = ppm / focus ppm, light = 0..1 normalised irradiance 0.38 m under the rail, ang = tangent angle deg in image, wf = visible width factor, inPortal/behindWall flags.
